name: Hiruko puppet shell
limitations: Finite shell mechanisms and conditional poison; shell can be broken. No Iron Sand or hundred-puppet army active through the shell.

name: Third Kazekage puppet
limitations: Carried human puppet needs control; antidotes and destroyed mechanisms can counter it. No concurrent hundred-puppet barrage.

name: Reanimated human body
limitations: Lacks original puppet collection/body mechanisms; uses available captured tools and people. Second move is descriptive; no Iron Sand or flamethrowers restored by Edo.

name: Living puppet body / retained collection
signatureMoves: Red Secret Technique: Performance of a Hundred Puppets
limitations: Vulnerable living core; finite puppet stock, conditional poison and counterable mechanisms. Equipment changes consume actions; not every puppet attack simultaneously active.
